steps: Try filling: sequence must be FXTFXTFXTFXT
Other options break the FXT cycle
check_code:
fixed={2:'X',4:'F',8:'X',9:'T',11:'X'}
blanks=[1,3,5,6,7,10,12]
opts={'A':'XTTFXFX','B':'FTXTFFT','C':'XFTTXFX','D':'FXXTFXT'}
def ok(o):
    s=dict(fixed)
    for p,c in zip(blanks,o): s[p]=c
    seq=''.join(s[i] for i in range(1,13))
    return seq=='FXT'*4
f=[k for k,v in opts.items() if ok(v)]
assert f==['B']
assert opts['B']=='FTXTFFT'

from itertools import permutations
sent=[({'mountain','stand','tall'},['33','66','44']),({'rocky','is','tall'},['44','55','11']),({'rocky','is','mountain'},['33','55','11'])]
words=['mountain','stand','tall','rocky','is']
codes=['11','33','44','55','66']
sols=[]
for p in permutations(codes):
    m=dict(zip(words,p))
    if all(sorted(m[w] for w in ws)==sorted(c) for ws,c in sent): sols.append(m)
assert len({m['stand'] for m in sols})==1
r=sols[0]['stand']
opts={'A':'33','B':'11','C':'44','D':'66'}
assert opts['D']==r
assert all(opts[k]!=r for k in 'ABC')
